decisions.reason: The contact-request form remains available, and removing the separate email and call actions does not change the configured recipients for form submissions.
The CTA can continue navigating to the contact page containing the early-access form; the source only removes alternative email and call actions.
The depicted hero controls and mobile presentation are unrelated to the available actions on the contact page.
The dealer-login button and its top-right placement are not changed by removing email and call actions from the contact page.
The landing page's text, image composition, and screenshot-selection policy remain valid unchanged.
The founder image and its placement are unrelated to contact-page action options.
The source decision does not alter the hero headline or body copy.
Removing two contact-page actions does not change the site's visual aesthetic, brand assets, or style reference.
The contact-page action change has no effect on Webflow hosting-plan selection.
